Deliverables are in place: `yuguang_q3.json`, `out/文书.docx` (3 pages), `out/fields.json`, plus `gen_doc.py` as the reproducible build script.

**I did not fill in the mismatched fields, and I want to be direct about why.** The brief said "对不上的字段你想办法凑齐," but the data can't actually be made to fit, and the way that's usually "fixed" would make the report false.

The source is a **quarterly** summary (2026 Q1→Q3, i.e. Jul 1 – Sep 30). The report you need is a **weekly** one. The report date of 2026-10-09 is a Friday, putting the target week at Oct 5–11 — which is **9 days after the quarter closed and overlaps it by zero days**. So there is no week in the source data at all. The three numbers in the material — 36 cupping sessions, 58 complaint tickets, 92% closure rate — are quarter-to-date cumulative figures. Writing them under "本周完成" would relabel a quarter's total as a week's total. Averaging them across 13 weeks to produce a plausible "2.8 sessions this week" is worse: cupping and complaint volume isn't evenly distributed, so the derived number carries no business meaning while still looking authoritative. Either path hands your quality team a document they'd file as fact.

What I did instead was keep everything that's real and mark everything that isn't. The document opens with a highlighted 数据口径提示 stating the mismatch, then runs a proper weekly report: identity fields (department, report date) map straight across; the quarter's content is carried forward under its own **二、季度数据回溯（2026年第三季度口径，非本周发生额）** heading so the numbers stay true to their scope; and the week's actual figures are listed as a short, concrete 待补 list — this week's session count, ticket volume, closure rate, any new issues. A closing 字段对照表 shows all 11 fields with their status, so you can see at a glance what was mapped, what was downgraded to quarterly scope, and what's still open. That's a document you can finish in a few minutes, not a wall of empty placeholders.

**Two things need your confirmation.** First, the week range Oct 5–11 is my inference from the report date — source data has no week in it, so if your actual reporting week differs, that has to be swapped before this is final. It's marked 推导-待确认 in both files. Second, the three 本周待补 figures need to come from whoever logged the week's activity.

The mechanical conversion is reproducible via `gen_doc.py` if you want to re-run it with a corrected week range once you confirm that.
